<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I am rewriting the social media intro for each blog post. The output will be pure JSON. Each draft must stay under 200 characters. Every intro must state that the link is in the comments.

The rewrite must name a concrete payoff on the site, such as a skip, fix, checklist, method, or story beat. The tone should be JoRap voice, free of AI bait and em dashes. I am now auditing each existing intro against these standards, starting with extension-cord.md.

Auditing reveals six posts with weak payoffs. "Why - link in comments" lacks a named payoff. "Why it stuck" is vague. "Why Git earned its place" could be sharper. "Framework?" and "story plus links" are unclear. All 22 intros will be rewritten with concrete payoffs and JoRap voice.

Drafting the first intro now. The scene is a five-advisor AI council token bill. The payoff is a one-agent six-hats workflow. I am counting characters to stay under 200.

The first draft is 157 characters. Next is the smart plug intro. It names two stack mismatch stories and the questions to ask first. The character count is roughly 155.

The stack mismatch draft is being tightened to fit under 200 characters. The study techniques intro names Justin Sung’s F-to-S ranking and the highlight trap. The Sveltia intro uses a client frozen at the word terminal and promises buttons without WordPress. Drafting of the Tailwind v4 intro has begun.

The Tailwind v4 intro names a broken Hugoplate upgrade checklist. The tenant-not-landlord intro names a vine note that vanished overnight. The three-places intro names lost work on rented PHP hosting. The why-brave-browser intro names Brave Shields cutting cookie popups on Linux.

The why-brave-browser draft is now about 165 characters. It contrasts personal tabs with billable tabs.

The why-git intro names a panic during a WordPress tweak and the git checkout -- . reset.

The wifi-router draft opens with a weekly reboot ritual on a cheap router.

The wifi-router draft names a before-you-buy checklist. The worcestershire-sauce draft uses a Pia and Perrins adobo splash. The xiaomi-is-the-new-huawei draft names Shopee charger listings and the Huawei-to-Xiaomi shift. The alex-eala-pro-career-tracker draft opens with Alex Eala coverage since Miami 2025.

The alex-eala-pro-career-tracker draft names pinned Twitter updates and a living scrapbook. The consistent-ai-output-wordpress-builds draft names a house rules document that stopped feature drift. The dnpap-song-resources draft names a studio cut, live cut, and videos kept in one place. The drupal-to-wordpress draft begins with a fall for Drupal's content modeling.

The drupal-to-wordpress draft names WordPress job posts, cost, and the switch moment. The extension-cord draft names a hotel outlet behind the bed and a cafe socket blocked by a fat charger. It also names the short extension cord and the length packed. The facebook-favorites-feed draft names Messenger, doom-scrolling, and favorites-only feeds. The getting-started-with-rss-feeds draft opens with RSS dying around 2010.

The rss-feeds draft names a plain setup that still works after two weeks on Inoreader. The google-over-apple-ecosystem draft is about 130 characters; it names a MacBook Pro M4 on Gmail and Drive, one Google account across Mac, Android, and Linux, and why it mixes brands instead of the full Apple loop. The hanamikoji-duopoly-retheme draft opens with a love for the split-you-choose puzzle, not the geisha art.

The hanamikoji draft now names a Duopoly retheme with dull flags and a build log of cuts from the box. I am verifying every character count manually. I will return only JSON, not edit files directly.
